explanation: Alfred Nobel's will gave the peace prize to a committee chosen by Norway's parliament. Sweden and Norway shared a king when he died in 1896; the other prizes are presented in Stockholm.

claims.text: The Nobel Peace Prize is presented in Oslo, Norway.
The Nobel Peace Prize is not presented in Stockholm, Geneva or Copenhagen.
Alfred Nobel's will specified that the peace prize be awarded by a committee of five people chosen by the Norwegian parliament (the Storting).
Sweden and Norway were in a union under one king when Alfred Nobel died in 1896.
The other Nobel Prizes are presented in Stockholm.
